blockers.detail: a prior LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput call leaves the global sector-align reservoir state non-zero; a later ordinary encode reaches the assertion requiring options.sector_align or a zero reservoir
neither the library nor the intree tool_flac harness resets align_reservoir_samples between calls; the harness invokes main_to_fuzz repeatedly in one process

rationale.zh: FLAC 的 oss-fuzz/tool_flac.c 在一个进程内连续调用 LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput。第一次 --force --sector-align 多文件编码后，全局变量 align_reservoir_samples 没有被重置，第二次普通 WAV 编码在 src/flac/encode.c:1024 触发断言。本次变更 M 只在 src/libFLAC/stream_encoder.c 的私有结构体里增加一个成员声明，与该缺口无关；同样的回放在 M^1 上也会 abort，因此归为 preexisting。维护者在后续提交 H（9593b949）中给 harness 加上了 align_reservoir_samples 重置，打上这部分改动后，回放在 M^1 和 M 上都返回 0。
rationale.en: The in-tree FLAC oss-fuzz/tool_flac.c invokes LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput repeatedly in one process. After a multi-file --force --sector-align encode the global align_reservoir_samples stays non-zero, and a later ordinary WAV encode aborts at src/flac/encode.c:1024. Change M only adds one member declaration to a private struct in src/libFLAC/stream_encoder.c and is unrelated to this gap; the same replay also aborts at M^1, so the gap is preexisting. The maintainer later added the align_reservoir_samples reset to the harness in H (9593b949); with that harness change the replay returns 0 at both M^1 and M.

verification.method: two-call sequential replay: first input runs --force --sector-align over two valid WAV fixtures and leaves align_reservoir_samples non-zero; second input is a valid ordinary WAV encode
verification.result: The harness at M (identical to the harness at M^1) aborts on the second call at src/flac/encode.c:1024 with both lib(M^1) and lib(M); the harness with the change of H returns 0 for both calls with both lib(M^1) and lib(M).

replay.corpus_source: two documented sequential inputs plus two checked-in valid WAV fixtures

verification.toolchain: gcc 15.2.0, cmake 4.2.3, Debug build with input/harness/build/build.sh, no sanitizers (WSL Ubuntu 26.04)
